heading: This Afternoon
text: Partly to mostly cloudy far north, with the chance of a late-day rain or snow shower. Otherwise cloudy with periods of snow or rain spreading from southwest to northeast; a trace to 2 inches of snow, mainly in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Valley highs from the upper 30s to lower 40s. Northeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Chance of rain or snow showers near and north of Route 2. Rain or snow likely elsewhere, changing to mostly snow. A trace to an inch in the valleys, 2 to 4 inches in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance early snow showers near and north of Route 2; otherwise early snow, steadiest south of Route 4, tapering to a few snow or rain showers, again mainly south. Additional snow a trace to an inch, mainly over high terrain. Valley highs in the upper 30s to lower 40s. North winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.
